# TypedStructor v0.6.1 - Table of Contents

TypedStructor is a library for defining structs with types effortlessly.

## Guides

- [Changelog](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Guides
  - [Introduction](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
  - [Migrate from typed_struct](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/migrate_from_typed_struct.md)

- Plugins
  - [Introduction to the plugin system](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/introduction.md)
  - [Registering plugins globally](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/registering_plugins_globally.md)
  - [Implement Access behavior](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/accessible.md)
  - [Implement reflection functions](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/reflection.md)

  - [Type Only on Ecto Schema](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/type_only_on_ecto_schema.md)
  - [Add primary key and timestamps types to your Ecto schema](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/primary_key_and_timestamps.md)
  - [Derives the Jason.Encoder for struct](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/derive_jason.md)
  - [Derives the Enumerable for struct](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/derive_enumerable.md)

## Modules

- [TypedStructor](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.md): 
- [TypedStructor.Definition](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.Definition.md): The definition struct that holds the `TypedStructor` options,
fields and parameters.

- [TypedStructor.Plugin](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.Plugin.md): This module defines the plugin behaviour for `TypedStructor`.
- [TypedStructor.Definer.Defexception](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.Definer.Defexception.md): A definer to define an exception and a type for a given definition.
- [TypedStructor.Definer.Defrecord](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.Definer.Defrecord.md): A definer to define record macros and a type for a given definition.
- [TypedStructor.Definer.Defrecordp](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.Definer.Defrecordp.md): A definer to define private record macros and a type for a given definition.
- [TypedStructor.Definer.Defstruct](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.Definer.Defstruct.md): A definer to define a struct and a type for a given definition.
- [TypedStructor.Definer.Utils](https://typed-structor.hexdocs.pm/TypedStructor.Definer.Utils.md): Utilities for definer modules.
